regime_detect.name: Market Regime
regime_detect.description: Current market regime (TRENDING_BULL / RANGING / TRENDING_BEAR / CRISIS / UNKNOWN) classified from SPY vs 200d SMA and VIX level with 3-day hysteresis + 33-day walkback fallback. Enables downstream Analysis and techtrade consumers to adapt composite scoring and position sizing to the current market state.

params.label: As Of
params.description: Snap the classification to this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

params.label: Lookback Days
params.description: SPY + VIX history window (minimum 233 for 200d SMA + 33d walkback).

params.label: Provider
params.description: OpenBB data provider. Omit to use the platform default.
